youtube_description:
Jesus... our dog died Tuesday. At work I said "weekend was good" and kept typing. 🐕

His dog died and he told the office nothing, only that his weekend was good.

He: Jesus... our dog died Tuesday. At work I said "weekend was good" and kept typing. 🐕

Jesus: You stopped at his bowl before leaving this morning.

He: It's just a dog. People lose so much more.

Jesus: Grief isn't a contest. He was yours.

He: Then why do I feel silly crying?

Jesus: Love that big leaves a big quiet. That's not silly.

Jesus: Weeping may stay the night, but morning is not forgotten.

“For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.”
Psalm 30:5 (BSB)
